topics.title: Types of Reinsurance Arrangements and Methods
topics.objective: The candidate will understand different types of traditional and advanced reinsurance transactions for life insurance.

outcomes.text: Describe basic terms and concepts related to reinsurance
Understand the key aspects of automatic and facultative reinsurance
Explain various methods and perform financial statement calculations of reinsurance transactions, including yearly renewable term, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, and funds withheld arrangements
Explain reasons for using inforce reinsurance, approaches used for inforce reinsurance, and advantages and disadvantages of each approach
Demonstrate knowledge of different forms of reinsurance for different products; specifically, PRTs/longevity swaps, annuity coinsurance, and life insurance yearly renewable term
Describe and evaluate types of non-proportional reinsurance transactions
Describe and evaluate types of reinsurance transactions for annuity contracts
Understand the role of private equity involvement in the global reinsurance market and the use of offshore reinsurance

topics.title: Transferring Risk
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the fundamentals of risk transfer between two counterparties.

outcomes.text: Describe the elements within reinsurance treaties
Describe the elements and considerations of risk transfer between counterparties, and evaluate their impact on reinsurance agreement provisions
Explain the considerations and process of managing insolvency of the ceding and assuming parties within a reinsurance transaction
Explain the types, uses, and functions of captive reinsurance transactions

topics.title: Key Accounting and Regulatory Considerations
topics.objective: The candidate will understand regulatory frameworks for reinsurance transactions across US, Canadian, and global jurisdictions.

outcomes.text: Describe and evaluate elements of reinsurance requirements within the US regulatory framework
Describe and evaluate elements of reinsurance requirements within the Canadian regulatory framework
Understand US GAAP and US Stat requirements related to reinsurance
Understand IFRS and OSFI requirements related to reinsurance
Understand key international reinsurance regulatory frameworks, especially as they relate to the use of offshore reinsurance and private equity backed reinsurers.
